headlines.title: Gritty Arsenal show different side in Barcelona draw
headlines.description: Could a resilient draw against European champions Barcelona be a turning point in Arsenal's season?

headlines.title: Arsenal dig in for draw at Barcelona to extend unbeaten start
headlines.description:
Arsenal extend their unbeaten start to four matches in the Uefa Women's Champions League, as they produce a dogged display to hold Barcelona to a 1-1 draw at the Camp Nou. 
The point moves Renee Slegers' side into the top four, putting them in a great position to automatically qualify for the knockout stages.

headlines.title: How 'Barca way' continues despite big-name exits
headlines.description: Arsenal face a much-changed Barcelona in the Women's Champions League on Thursday - but how have the Spanish giants coped so well with losing key players?
